reasoning: One of the most-translated ancient Egyptian texts. Davies (1908) gave the first scholarly English rendering; Wilson translated it for Pritchard's ANET (Princeton UP, 1st ed. 1950); Lichtheim (1976, UC Press) produced the canonical modern scholarly translation. Multiple complete English translations precede ours by decades.
